cause_quote: The new `if (runtimeHasSourceLoader())` guard rejected built helpers because `return hasNodeStartupHooks(process.execArgv, process.env.NODE_OPTIONS);` treated an inherited instrumentation `--import` as a source loader.
user_saw: On Linux, every supervised non-PTY exec failed with a child cleanup error when the Gateway ran with an instrumentation startup hook in NODE_OPTIONS.
summary: The fix strips startup hooks from the relay and anchor environments while preserving the original environment for the executed command.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent and confirmed that the relay already passed its environment to the anchor and that the built JavaScript owner passed the filename check and acquired Linux subreaper ownership even with a preload. The causing diff replaced that check with startup-hook detection, so the same inherited `--import` caused the built owner to fail before acquiring ownership.
